tours.title: Evening Desert Safari
tours.description: The quintessential Dubai safari. Thrilling dune bashing in Red Lahbab sands, traditional Bedouin camp hospitality, live BBQ dinner buffet, and captivating cultural shows.

tours.title: Morning Desert Safari
tours.description: Ideal for travelers tight on schedule or those wishing to beat the midday warmth. Witness magical first light over pristine windswept crests with coffee and dates.

tours.title: Private Desert Safari VIP
tours.description: An exclusive private Land Cruiser solely reserved for your family or group. Includes dedicated desert guide, custom pickup schedules, VIP camp seating and table-side service.

tours.title: Quad Bike ATV Rental
tours.description: Conquer open desert dunes on high-performance 250 CC to 350 CC Quad Bikes. Full freedom in open desert dunes with helmet, goggles, and safety guide escort. Direct desert meeting point (free) or private 4x4 luxury transfer available.

tours.title: Can-Am Dune Buggy Safari
tours.description: Drive 2-seater or 4-seater Can-Am Maverick X3 Turbo buggies with roll cages, 4-point harnesses, and desert guides. Direct meeting point at Lahbab camp or private 4x4 luxury transfer available.

tours.title: Dubai Half-Day City Tour
tours.description: Witness the transformation from ancient fishing village to glittering metropolis. Includes Burj Al Arab photo stop, Dubai Frame, Gold & Spice Souk, and Dubai Mall.

tours.title: Abu Dhabi Tour from Dubai
tours.description: Full-day capital journey featuring the awe-inspiring Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Emirates Palace photo opportunity, Abu Dhabi Corniche, and Ferrari World Yas Island.

tours.title: Marina Luxury Dhow Cruise
tours.description: Sail along Dubai Marina's world-renowned skyline. Enjoy an international 5-star buffet dinner, soft drinks, ambient music, and live Tanoura dance performances.

tours.title: Burj Khalifa At The Top (124th & 125th Floor)
tours.description: Ascend to the 124th and 125th floors of the iconic Burj Khalifa in high-speed double-deck elevators at 10m/s. Experience 360-degree panoramic glass views over Dubai, Arabian Gulf, outdoor observation terrace, and state-of-the-art telescopes.
highlights: Direct Dubai Mall Ground Floor Entry

tours.title: Burj Khalifa Fountain Lake Ride
tours.description: Glide across the 30-acre Burj Lake on a traditional wooden motorized Abra. Witness the world largest choreographed fountain dancing to Arabic and international hits right next to your boat with illuminated water jets rising 140 meters high.
highlights: Direct Sightline to Burj Khalifa LED Show

tours.title: Sky Dive Dubai Tandem Palm Jumeirah
tours.description: The pinnacle of skydiving in Dubai. Freefall at over 120 mph (190 km/h) harnessed to a world-class USPA-licensed tandem master from 13,000 feet directly above the legendary Palm Jumeirah. Includes dedicated camera flyer with high-definition video and photo package.

tours.title: Miracle Garden + Global Village Combo
tours.description: Dual iconic Dubai attraction combo featuring a dedicated private luxury vehicle (AED 500 base for up to 2 pax, +AED 50 for each extra pax after 2) and official combo entry tickets (AED 130 per person). Explore 150 million blooming flowers at Dubai Miracle Garden in the afternoon, followed by 90+ cultural country pavilions and night shows at Global Village.
highlights: Private Dedicated Car for Your Group (AED 500 for 1-2 Pax)
+AED 50 for Each Additional Pax after 2 Pax
